name: fixture.tf
notes: 명시적 LPP → GDS 맵과 DRF 색상 데이터만 적용합니다.
3D 높이/두께는 표시용입니다. 기술 파일의 DRC·모델·공정 물리 stack은 실행하거나 추정하지 않습니다.

source.text:
; Synthetic parser grammar fixture. Internal numbers deliberately differ from GDS.
layerDefinitions(
  techLayers(
    (metal1 100 M1)
    (poly 200 PO)
  )
  techPurposes((drawing 252 drw)(pin 251 pin))
  techLayerPurposePriorities((metal1 drawing)(metal1 pin)(poly drawing))
  techDisplays(
    (metal1 drawing metalRed t t t t t)
    (metal1 pin metalRed t nil t t t)
    (poly drawing polyGreen t t t t t)
  )
)
layerRules(streamLayers((metal1 17 0 t)(poly 8 0 t)))
constraintGroups((foundry spacings(minWidth("metal1" 0.05))))
include("$PDK_ROOT/unknown.il")

companion_sources.text:
; Synthetic grammar only. No commercial sample copied.
drDefineDisplay((display))
drDefineColor((display red 255 0 0)(display green 0 200 40))
drDefinePacket(
 (display metalRed blank solid red red)
 (display polyGreen blank solid green green outline)
)
drDefineStipple((display custom ((1 0)(0 1))))
